annotations.text:
Columns are the three themes; rows are Dashboard, Log a Meal, AI Estimate.

Dashed orange ring = a pair under 4.5:1. The chip beside it is the measured ratio.

--color-success on cream is 3.58:1 at 12px in .macro-status.is-ok.

The worst pair in the palette, and it is in the LIGHT theme. The notebook equivalent passes at 5.30:1.

--color-text-faint is 4.26:1 off-today.

The light theme already fixed this once (#9ca3af -> #6b7280, per the comment in index.css). The notebook override reintroduced a light faint and never got the same treatment.

--color-primary as .btn-ghost text is 4.30:1 off-today.

btn-primary, btn-ai and btn-secondary all have notebook overrides. btn-ghost has none.
What already holds up: modal chrome, inputs, the highlight panel, btn-primary, btn-ai and status colours all clear AA in all three themes. The dialog overrides are doing their job.
